decision.summary: Implement the previously reviewed corrections in an isolated candidate, using unknown state when no trusted telemetry source exists.
alternatives: Retain static healthy fixtures as production state (rejected).
Use one typed observation projection with safe unavailable behavior and explicit simulation (selected).
counterevidence: Pure model tests already pass; they should remain distinct from live evidence.
Mainline advanced with multimedia fixtures; preserve their historical artifacts and label simulation rather than claim physical evolution.

No trusted live physiology/peer evidence adapter is inferred from constant JSON.
